_comment: Search aliases for the handbook website. Each alias maps a common search term to handbook pages and/or glossary terms, so e.g. searching 'sword' surfaces the Weapons chapter. Targets are page names (as shown in the sidebar, with or without the .md) or glossary terms (e.g. 'Health (HP)'). Targets resolve SOFTLY: if a page is renamed, the site still finds it by section number, similar name, or a matching heading inside it, so aliases keep working after renames. Unknown targets are silently ignored. Edits take effect on page reload.

aliases.alias: jar o' gel cube slime mass
